lines.text: @maya_front climbs the last steps onto @peak_dawn, breathing hard.
Clouds roll far below, lit gold by the rising sun.
She drops her backpack on the rock.
@maya_front spreads her arms. Wind whips her jacket and hair.
She tilts her head back and laughs.
The sun clears the horizon and floods the summit with light.
She stands still, small against the endless sky.

writes.note: I drafted a short summit scene from your line: arrival, backpack drop, arms out in the wind.

reply.rationale: Expanded the one-line action into a single-location 15 s scene of seven short action beats (about 14 s), visual only, keeping @maya_front and @peak_dawn as written.
